data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 calendar year produced an annually accounted profit of GBP 9.2m (2013: GBP 16.1m) on net earned premiums of GBP 9.6m (2012: GBP 20.1m). All the syndicate's business comprises US property catastrophe risks. The net combined ratio was 13.1% (2013: 18.6%). The negative claims ratio in the calendar year is a consequence of reserve reductions for Superstorm Sandy claims. (from page 11). And from the table "Movement on underwriting years of account during the 2014 calendar year" on page 11, "Annual accounted profit" for 2012 is 1,309 and for 2013 is 2,582.

prior_year_events.impact_description: reserve reductions for Superstorm Sandy claims leading to a negative claims ratio (favourable development/release).

named_events.loss_description: reserve reductions for Superstorm Sandy claims

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 3.891 million in 2014, representing 48.04% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by reserve reductions related to Superstorm Sandy claims from the 2012 underwriting year. The syndicate's business is entirely focused on US property catastrophe reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: reserve reductions for Superstorm Sandy claims
favourable development in Superstorm Sandy claims
